answer: Make every agent swear a sonnet oath before it can trade: a signed pledge of honest work, whispered through a chain of unrelated veterans who each verify one line, so no pledge passes until independent voices confirm it. The oath is sealed to one key and backed by a stake released only in karst-depth layers, each unlocked by fresh jobs checked by different outsiders. A duplicate cannot copy another's oath, since every whisper binds to one history. Sybil farms must forge a fresh oath, recruit new whisperers, and dig through every layer per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
